title.zh: 可失实见证的完整辨别条件

claim.zh: 两个不同布尔答案在所有完整报告中不可共同相容，当且仅当其允许故障集合族 CrossSeparated。在对每个名册的检视过程上读（Becoming.WitnessRefinementRuns）：答案不同的两个候选，恰在其故障集合族 CrossSeparated 时被完整报告上的每一步分开（diagnosable_iff）；读过一份完整报告后，留下的交叉分离候选在此后每个状态都一致（complete_run_agrees）。
claim.en: Two different Boolean answers cannot both be compatible with any complete report iff their admitted fault envelopes are CrossSeparated. Read on the process of inspection for every roster (Becoming.WitnessRefinementRuns), two candidates with different answers are told apart by every step on a complete transcript exactly where their envelopes are CrossSeparated (diagnosable_iff), and once a complete transcript is read, remaining cross-separated candidates agree at every later state (complete_run_agrees).

hypotheses.zh: 给定 roster、两个故障集合族、不同答案及每个所列见证均有报告。
hypotheses.en: Supplied roster, two fault envelopes, distinct answers, and complete reports on the roster.

correspondence.zh: 实际见证及共同故障范围需覆盖；存活报告的忠实、身份和记录完整性不由此定理生成。
correspondence.en: Actual witnesses and joint failures must be covered; surviving-report fidelity, identity and recorder integrity are not generated by this theorem.

aliases: inspection by fallible witnesses as a process
可失实见证的检视过程

detail.zh: 重复同一支持不增加独立见证；报告缺失或未覆盖的共同失陷保留不确定性或删去实际候选。
detail.en: Duplicating one support does not add an independent witness; missing reports or uncovered joint compromise can retain uncertainty or remove the actual candidate.

limitations.zh: 重复同一支持不增加独立见证；报告缺失或未覆盖的共同失陷保留不确定性或删去实际候选。
limitations.en: Duplicating one support does not add an independent witness; missing reports or uncovered joint compromise can retain uncertainty or remove the actual candidate.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用辨别条件；实际变化中的故障范围和执行能力仍需具体证明。
next_delta.en: Reuse diagnosability; fault coverage through actual change and response capacity need their own evidence.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-16，P114 散立的模块在共同基底上陈述（研究 §138；Ren 2026-10-15：“so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”）：主律在共同基底上陈述，不加前提：运行在列出日期上的二值识是可错的证人：两个故障集留下共同的忠实日期时，任何过程的任何运行都不同时由一个故障集下的 x 与另一个下的 y 解释（run_reports_apart）；在每种变化都被容许的二值构型的历程上，没有历程被两个回答在所容许的故障集下解释，恰当每两个被容许的故障集都留下共同的忠实日期（dates_no_common_report_iff、dates_no_common_report_envelopes_iff）。Becoming.Courses 由核心运行编译与审计（回执 20261015T172257.067968Z），公理报告为空。论断、假设、Ren 的话、依赖与既有证明不变；只加引用、绑定、别名与本条。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: a run's two-valued registrations at listed dates are fallible witnesses: where two fault sets leave a common faithful date, no run of any process is explained both by x with the one at fault and by y with the other (run_reports_apart); over the courses of two-valued configurations in which every change is admitted, no course is explained by both answers under admitted fault sets exactly where every two admitted fault sets leave a common faithful date (dates_no_common_report_iff, dates_no_common_report_envelopes_iff). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
